scenario: [LSER.17.2] / [LSER.14.1]: `min` and `max` over `all_time` return the slot's type, nullable, over the whole history with no forgetting, on the running-stats backing (SeriesBackendWelfordEwma, [LSER.18.1] -- on a window they ride the monotonic deque instead). Values 5, 2, 9 then 6, one per pump, each read pre-sample ([LSER.8.6.1]): cold is `null` (no log), then [5] -> 5 and 5, [5, 2] -> 2 and 5, [5, 2, 9] -> 2 and 9. Drives libds `welford_ewma.c`'s running `min_v` / `max_v` and the Mercury `ds.series` `agg_min` / `agg_max` over the all-time samples. The text `min 2` pins the Int slot's type.
rules_ds:
use default

schema Reading scope logical:
    dev: String key
    level: Int mutable

series Reading.level (by: dev):
    min, max all_time

rule r:
    Reading s where s.min is not null
->
    log info "min {s.min} max {s.max}"
